title: 第5章 城中的羞辱
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
五日后，队伍临近茶州州城。

    远远，便看到一座雄伟大城屹立其中！

    大周占据大陆东边，疆域辽阔，辖下四十三州，依照富庶程度，划分上、中、下三等。

    眼前的茶州，位列顶尖的上等大州，有接近千万的人口，是整个云州的十倍多。

    其内，以茶闻名，盛产各类珍稀好茶。

    这些好茶不仅能够提神醒脑，还能够滋养经脉，增强武者气血，深受武者喜爱。

    其中的云雾岭茶更是被武皇钦定为御茶！

    马车里，陆舟撩开车帘一角，望向远处茶州城，心潮澎湃。

    终于要进城了！

    短短五日，依靠这发钱系统，他已获得了四百多万两白银。

    武道境界更是一路突飞猛进，从八品顶级一路飙升至七品高级，堪称坐火箭！

    可境界越是往上，突破所需耗费的白银便成倍暴涨。

    此刻他手中虽仍余下两百余万两白银，却已不足以支撑他冲击下一重境界。

    终究，还是要积攒更多钱财才行！

    想到这，他又看了眼系统。

    今日到账的收益，是87万4千5百11两白银！

    相较于第一天，收入少了整整一百一十一两白银。

    这就意味着云州在这短短数日，已经流失了上百名百姓，平均每天损失二十两左右白银。

    这数字很可怕！

    若不加以管控的话，人口流失会越来越严重！

    这些天来，武道突破需要的钱越来越多……

    但若云州人口是负增长的话，日后别说氪金变强了，逍遥日子都过不下去了。

    经历过系统加持，陆舟又怎甘再由俭入奢？

    “这云州到底是什么情况！”陆舟揉了揉眉心。

    鞭长莫及的他，一时间也想不出什么办法。

    只想着等会到了城中好好了解一下云州的信息，提前做好功课，省得到时抓瞎。

    除此之外，顺带也可以购买一些功法武技。

    武道一途，境界是基础，功法则是安身之本，而武技则能显著提升自身战斗力！

    三者，缺一不可！

    往后若暂时没办法冲击更高境界，深耕功法武技，照样能稳步提高自身实力。

    就比如此前的遇袭，那时的他全无章法，只能依靠本能战斗，很是狼狈。
content_en:
Five days later, the team approached the city of Chazhou.

    From a distance, I saw a majestic city standing in it!

    The Great Zhou Dynasty occupies the eastern part of the mainland and has a vast territory. It has forty-three states under its jurisdiction, which are divided into upper, middle and lower levels according to the degree of wealth.

    The Chazhou in front of us is one of the top large states, with a population of close to ten million, which is more than ten times that of the entire Yunzhou.

    It is famous for tea and is rich in all kinds of rare and fine tea.

    These good teas can not only refresh the mind, but also nourish the meridians and enhance the Qi and blood of warriors, so they are deeply loved by warriors.

    Among them, Yunwuling tea was designated as imperial tea by Emperor Wu!

    In the carriage, Lu Zhou lifted a corner of the curtain and looked at Chazhou City in the distance, his heart racing.

    Finally entering the city!

    In just five days, relying on this money distribution system, he had obtained more than four million taels of silver.

    The level of martial arts has been advancing by leaps and bounds, soaring from the top level of the eighth level to the advanced level of the seventh level. It can be called a rocket!

    But the higher the level, the more silver it costs to break through.

    Although he still had more than two million taels of silver left in his hand at this moment, it was no longer enough to support him in reaching the next level.

    After all, you still have to save more money!

    Thinking of this, he looked at the system again.

    The income received today is 874,511 taels of silver!

    Compared with the first day, the income was a full one hundred and eleven taels less.

    This means that Yunzhou has lost hundreds of people in just a few days, and an average of about twenty taels of silver per day.

    This number is terrible!

    If it is not controlled, population loss will become more and more serious!

    These days, more and more money is needed for martial arts breakthroughs...

    But if the population of Yunzhou is growing at a negative rate, let alone krypton gold becoming stronger in the future, it will be impossible to live a happy life.

    After experiencing the blessing of the system, how could Lu Zhou be willing to switch from frugality to luxury?

    "What is going on in Yunzhou!" Lu Zhou rubbed his brows.

    He was beyond his reach and couldn't think of any solution for a while.

    I just want to get to know the information about Yunzhou when I get to the city, and do my homework in advance to avoid being blinded when I get there.

    In addition, you can also purchase some martial arts skills.

    In the path of martial arts, realm is the foundation, the law of martial arts is the foundation, and martial arts can significantly improve one's combat effectiveness!

    All three are indispensable!

    If you are unable to reach a higher level in the future, you can still steadily improve your strength by deeply cultivating martial arts and martial arts.

    For example, when he was attacked before, he was completely disorganized and could only rely on instinct to fight, which was very embarrassing.
